taskPreset.title: Manage HagiCode MonoSpecs
taskPreset.description: Initialize configuration, add repositories, or reorder MonoSpecs repositories by activity.

panel.contextSectionDescription: Choose the only writable project and optional read-only references.
panel.projectHint: The task may write only in the selected project root.
panel.repositoryAccessHint: Optional; these repositories may be read but never modified.
panel.repositoryAccessEmpty: No reference repositories are available for this project.
panel.operationSectionDescription: Choose an operation and provide complete instructions.
panel.commandHint: Choose initialize, add repositories, or reorder repositories.
panel.operationDescriptionHint: For adding repositories, provide one or more absolute URLs; for reordering, describe the intent.
panel.operationDescriptionPlaceholder:
Example: https://github.com/example/repo
Or: organize repositories by recent use.

initialize.description: Initialize or inspect the project configuration without overwriting valid data.

addRepository.description: Infer, validate, and append one or more repository URLs in input order.

reorderRepositories.description: Preview activity-based ordering and require confirmation before writing.

errors.invalidConfiguration: The MonoSpecs configuration is invalid; no write was performed.
errors.invalidUrl: Repository URLs must be valid absolute URLs.
errors.duplicatePath: The inferred repository path already exists or is duplicated.
errors.confirmationRequired: Explicit user confirmation is required before reordering.
errors.validationFailed: Full configuration validation failed before writing.
